run_benchmark_make_local: run a benchmark that measures time to create and close a local CompilerGym environment
run_benchmark_make_service: run a benchmark that measures time to create and close a CompilerGym service-connected environment
run_benchmark_reset: run a benchmark that measures the time to reset a CompilerGym environment
run_benchmark_step: run a benchmark that measures the time to execute a single action step in a CompilerGym environment
run_benchmark_fork: run a benchmark that measures the time to fork and close a CompilerGym environment
